title: Some results on null ideals of finite rings
summary: For a finite associative unital ring $R$, the null ideal of $R$ is the collection of polynomials with coefficients from $R$ that send each element of $R$ to zero under evaluation. It was conjectured that the null ideal of $R$ is always a two-sided ideal of its overlying polynomial ring. The conjecture was proved to be false with the construction of a subring of $4 \times 4$ upper triangular matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$ for which the null ideal is not two-sided.
